canonical_title: Failure of external load suspension system

versions.title_at_revision: Failure of external load suspension system
versions.text:
Standard: Any single failure of a suspension system element such as attachment fittings, slings, pendants, apex fittings, and cargo hooks does not result in loss of control of the rotary-wing or cause damage to the airframe. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess that any single failure of a suspension system element such as attachment fittings, slings, pendants, apex fittings, and cargo hooks does not result in loss of control of the air vehicle or cause damage to the airframe as specified in ADS-33E-PRF, Failure of External Load System paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the external loads SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess that any single failure of a suspension system element such as attachment fittings, slings, pendants, apex fittings, and cargo hooks does not result in loss of control of the air vehicle or cause damage to the airframe as specified in ADS-33E-PRF, Failure of External Load System paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the external loads SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess that any single failure of a suspension system element such as attachment fittings, slings, pendants, apex fittings, and cargo hooks does not result in loss of control of the air vehicle or cause damage to the airframe as specified in ADS-33E-PRF, Failure of External Load System paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the external loads SFE.
